title: Far-Right Wins in Pyrénées-Orientales Threaten Local Historical Memory
detail: Far-right victories in municipal elections in Pyrénées-Orientales are threatening local historical memory and cultural narratives, raising concerns about the durability of Republican institutions at the local level. Le Monde reports that RN-led municipal administrations are reshaping how communities interpret and commemorate their shared histories, challenging established Republican frameworks.
